class: T4 architecture direction validation (opt-in evaluation route; no production promotion, no target change)
originating_constraint: User challenge of the 5.5 tok/s ceiling claim: '5.5 tok/s 哪门子上限,赶紧研究解决的路径,用 e2e 的方式测试' -- the 6x GQA-redundant values read was previously (wrongly) classified as L2-absorbed; this record proves it is a real DRAM cost and validates the split-chunk GQA-shared fix end-to-end on the real P40000 API
supersedes: the L2-absorption finding in qwen36-27b-decode-hardware-bound-2026-09-26.json (corrected in place the same day)

kernel.name: attention_values_split_shared_24_4_256_kernel + attention_values_split_finalize_24_4_256_kernel
kernel.translation_unit: src/kernels/reference/attention_values_split_shared.cu (dedicated TU so the production decode_ops.cu ptxas resource layout for the warp-RMS contract kernel is unaffected)
kernel.shape: grid (chunks, 4) x 512 threads, 32 KiB dynamic smem per block (64-position x 256-dim bf16 V tile), 6 query heads per 256-thread group, per-thread 3-way FMA, atomicAdd into a persistent 24 KiB fp32 accumulator (lazy cudaMalloc, reused across steps), bf16 finalize kernel over 6144 elements
kernel.selection: S >= 512 AND Q3X_ENABLE_SPLIT_VALUES set AND stream not capturing (cudaStreamIsCapturing guard keeps captured graphs on the production 3-node attention topology); production default (no env var) is the bit-exact unroll-128 kernel, unchanged

microbench_s40000_ms_per_layer.numerical_s1024: 0/6144 exact-output differences vs the production kernel at S=1024 (few-ULP level; the split path is NOT bit-exact in general due to non-deterministic cross-chunk atomicAdd order)

p40000_api_e2e.request: P40000/O16 /v1/completions, body sha256 6fb5c1cedfd37f9d50036e8c98f985bcff0269331e1e051c205e8434eb313944, max_tokens=16, stream=true, temperature=0.0, seed=42
p40000_api_e2e.method: same rebuilt ELF, back-to-back same-host runs (split env on, then env off), preflight each time (no competing process, >=40 GB free, sync + drop_caches, tegrastats idle)

baseline_no_env.tokens_16: Based on the provided repository files, here is the analysis of the current state,

p40000_api_e2e.speedup: 1.17x per decode step (27.8 ms saved per step; microbenchmark prediction 16 full-attention layers x 1.11 ms = 17.8 ms, e2e slightly larger within run-to-run variance)
p40000_api_e2e.token_divergence: the two runs produce completely different 16-token completions: the split path is not bit-exact (atomicAdd cross-chunk accumulation order is non-deterministic), and a few-ULP per-layer difference cascades through 64 layers at temperature 0.0. Both completions are individually coherent; the divergence is the expected consequence of the non-deterministic combine, not a correctness defect of either path in isolation.

tests: q3x_decode_ops_cuda_test passes in both modes (default and Q3X_ENABLE_SPLIT_VALUES=1); the capture guard keeps the S513 graph-launch test and the bulk-GQA 3-node topology contracts green under the opt-in env var
production_accuracy_impact: the opt-in path changes completion tokens on the P40000 request and is therefore an evaluation/development route only (Q3X_ENABLE_SPLIT_VALUES); the production default remains the bit-exact unroll-128 route and is untouched
ceiling_update: with the split values path the realistic batch-one ceiling moves from ~181 ms/step (~5.5 tok/s) to weight floor 101.5 + split values ~24.0 + scores 38.6 + launch ~0.7 = ~165 ms/step (~6.1 tok/s); the measured 165.2 ms/step (6.05 tok/s) matches it. The 10 tok/s target (100 ms/step) remains below the 101.5 ms weight-read floor and is unreachable for batch-one on this device; the scores kernel's 6x GQA key read (38.6 ms/step) is the next candidate for the same treatment
status: opt-in evaluation route validated e2e; not release-qualified; token divergence requires owner adjudication before any production consideration
